name: Stealth
description: Move silently and remain unseen, reducing the chance of detection.

name: Lockpicking
description: Open locked doors and chests using cunning and simple tools.

name: Pickpocket
description: Swipe small items or coins from unaware targets.

name: Backstab
description: Deal extra damage when attacking an unsuspecting foe from behind.

name: Fire Magic
description: Harness flames to scorch enemies or ignite obstacles.

name: Ice Magic
description: Manipulate cold to freeze enemies or create slippery surfaces.

name: Lightning Magic
description: Channel electricity to shock and stun opponents.

name: Healing Magic
description: Mend wounds and cure ailments for yourself or allies.

name: Shielding Magic
description: Conjure protective barriers to lessen incoming damage.

name: Archery
description: Improve accuracy and damage with bows and crossbows.

name: Dual Wielding
description: Effectively fight while holding a weapon in each hand.

name: Alchemy
description: Brew potions and poisons from gathered ingredients.

name: Tracking
description: Follow trails and identify the presence of creatures nearby.

name: Speechcraft
description: Persuade or deceive others through conversation.
